sources.title: MiniCPM5 1B Claude Opus Fable5 Thinking - llmrun.dev
sources.snippet: MiniCPM5 1B Claude Opus Fable5 Thinking — Hardware Requirements & GPU Compatibility Chat MiniCPM5 1B Claude Opus Fable5 Thinking is a 1.1B-parameter open language model from GnLOLot in the MiniCPM family. It supports a context window of up to 131,072 tokens. At Q4_K_M it needs about 0.99 GB of VRAM — see which GPUs and Macs can run it below.
